totp.label: Authenticator app
totp.description: Use an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, 1Password, etc.) to generate 6-digit codes

email.label: Email code
email.description: Send a 6-digit code to your account email when you sign in

webauthn.label: Security key / passkey
webauthn.description: Sign in with a hardware key like YubiKey, or your device's fingerprint or face unlock. Resists phishing.

rpName.label: Display name
rpName.description: The service name browsers show when creating a passkey.

rpId.label: RP ID (domain)
rpId.description: The domain credentials are bound to. Blank = the account center (apps/platform) domain. Must be that domain or a parent; changing it later breaks existing keys.

userVerification.label: User verification
userVerification.description: required: always fingerprint, face or PIN; preferred: when supported; discouraged: touch only.

authenticatorAttachment.label: Allowed authenticators
authenticatorAttachment.description: any; platform: built-in only (Touch ID, Windows Hello); crossPlatform: hardware keys only.

passkeyLogin.label: Passkeys replace passwords
passkeyLogin.description: enabled: the sign-in page offers "Sign in with a passkey", signing in with a registered passkey (with fingerprint, face or PIN) without a password or second step; disabled: second step only. Not available for SSO-only domains.

sms.label: SMS code
sms.description: Text a 6-digit code to your phone when you sign in

provider.label: SMS provider
provider.description: twilio: Twilio; webhook: your own SMS gateway (HMAC-signed HTTP POST).

twilioFrom.label: Sender
twilioFrom.description: E.164 number (+1…), Messaging Service SID (MG…), or an alphanumeric sender ID.

webhookUrl.label: Gateway URL
webhookUrl.description: Must be https and public in production. A ping is sent when you save.

allowedCountryCodes.label: Allowed country codes
allowedCountryCodes.description: Comma separated (e.g. 1,44). Codes are only sent to these countries to prevent SMS pumping.

telegram.label: Telegram
telegram.description: A Telegram bot sends a 6-digit code when you sign in

botToken.label: Bot token
botToken.description: From @BotFather. Saving points the bot's webhook at this service.

botUsername.label: Bot username
botUsername.description: Filled in automatically when you save.

line.label: LINE
line.description: A LINE official account sends a 6-digit code when you sign in

channelAccessToken.label: Channel access token
channelAccessToken.description: Long-lived token issued on the Messaging API page in LINE Developers.

channelSecret.label: Channel secret
channelSecret.description: Verifies webhook signatures. Saving sets the webhook URL automatically.

botBasicId.label: Official account ID
botBasicId.description: Filled in automatically when you save.
